yt.title: The Nurse Everyone Loved… (True Story) | Part 1 #shorts
yt.description:
Jolly Jane: the true story of Jane Toppan, a nurse in 1880s-1900s Massachusetts who later confessed to 31 murders. Dramatised retelling; dialogue is imagined. Part 1 of 5.

#truecrime #horror #history #shorts

line.text: Massachusetts, the eighteen eighties. In a quiet hospital ward, one young nurse was loved by everyone.
Don't you worry, dear. Nurse Jane will take good care of you.
Patients called her Jolly Jane. Always smiling. Always kind.
But on the nights she worked, something strange kept happening. Some of her patients grew worse.
No one suspected the friendly nurse. Not yet.
Shh. Sleep now, dear. Just sleep.
Years later, she would confess to thirty one murders. This is the true story of Jane Toppan.

card.h: WHY DID NO ONE STOP HER?

line.text: Why did no one stop her? Tell me in the comments. Part two is next.
